parts.label: A
parts.prompt: On the dot below, which represents the block, draw and label the forces (not components) that act on the block while the force is applied. Each force must be represented by a distinct arrow starting on the dot.

common_errors: adds a force of motion

required_elements: horizontal arrow in the direction of motion
common_errors: draws the applied force at an angle

rubric_rows.criterion: The weight and the normal force arrows have the same length because the block has no vertical acceleration
required_elements: equal lengths of weight and normal force
common_errors: draws the normal force longer than the weight

parts.label: B

parts.model_answer: $a=F/m=ct/m$ and $v=\int_0^t a\,dt'=ct^2/(2m)$.

common_errors: treats the acceleration as constant, $a=c/m$

rubric_rows.criterion: Integrates the acceleration with respect to time
common_errors: multiplies the acceleration by the time instead of integrating

rubric_rows.criterion: Obtains $v(t)=ct^2/(2m)$ using the initial condition $v(0)=0$
common_errors: omits the factor of one half

parts.label: C
